title: Prediction of physical characteristics of disordered proteins using molecular simulation and physics-informed multiple machine learning strategies
authors: Diego Linares Gonzalez; Shahana Ibrahim; Swarnadeep Seth; George Atia; Aniket Bhattacharya
one_liner_zh: 该文用混合机器学习框架（序列模型+粗粒化物理特征+注意力机制）预测无序蛋白的构象性质（如回旋半径），虽聚焦单链构象而非直接PPI，但其序列-物理特征融合与可解释性建模思路对IDP互作机制建模有迁移启发。
abstract: We introduce a novel hybrid machine learning (ML) framework to predict the radius of gyration and other conformational properties of intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs). Our model integrates sequence information with physical features derived from a coarse-grained (CG) model validated by experimental data. Specifically, we combine hidden states from sequence-based models with 23 physical features projected into a shared latent space, and apply an attention mechanism that assigns weights to each residue to highlight the most informative regions of the sequence. This attention-guided fusion significantly improves predictive accuracy across multiple metrics, including MAPE and MSE, while also enhancing confidence in the predictions. We trained and evaluated our models on Brownian dynamics (BD) simulation results for approximately 7,000 IDPs from the MobiDB database (each with > 99% disorder score). We find that sequence-based models consistently outperform feature-only models, with the GRU achieving the best performance among sequence-only approaches. Moreover, combining sequence and feature information further improves accuracy across all architectures, with the hybrid biGRU model delivering the best overall predictive performance. SHAP analysis reveals the relative importance of physical features, offering model explainability and guiding feature selection. Notably, using a small number of top features often reduces model complexity and improves generalization. Furthermore an integrated gradient analysis reveals that apart from the length of the IDPs, the three parameters (SCD, SHD, and f * ) play key role in ML predictions. Our framework provides a fast, interpretable, and scalable tool for predicting IDP behavior, enabling efficient initial screening prior to costly molecular simulations.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的混合机器学习（ML）框架，用于预测固有无序蛋白质（IDPs）的回转半径及其他构象性质。我们的模型将序列信息与由粗粒化（CG）模型导出的物理特征相结合，该模型已通过实验数据验证。具体而言，我们将基于序列模型的隐藏状态与投影到共享潜在空间中的23个物理特征相结合，并应用注意力机制为每个残基分配权重，以突出序列中最具信息量的区域。这种注意力引导的融合显著提高了多个指标（包括MAPE和MSE）的预测准确性，同时增强了对预测的置信度。我们在来自MobiDB数据库（每个IDP的紊乱评分> 99%）的约7,000个IDPs的布朗动力学（BD）模拟结果上训练并评估了我们的模型。我们发现，基于序列的模型始终优于仅基于特征的模型，其中GRU在仅序列方法中表现最佳。此外，将序列与特征信息结合进一步提高了所有架构的准确性，其中混合biGRU模型提供了最佳的整体预测性能。SHAP分析揭示了物理特征的相对重要性，提供了模型可解释性并指导特征选择。值得注意的是，使用少量顶级特征通常能降低模型复杂度并改善泛化能力。此外，积分梯度分析显示，除了IDPs的长度外，三个参数（SCD、SHD和f *）在ML预测中起关键作用。我们的框架为预测IDP行为提供了一种快速、可解释且可扩展的工具，能够在昂贵的分子模拟之前实现高效的初步筛选。
